description: Search MarketHeist's 90 published research pages and get the page's own verdict and numbers, with its URL to cite: 18 strategy guides (60/40, All Weather, Golden Butterfly, DCA vs lump sum, ...), 26 fund-history pages (how far back an ETF can be tested), 18 trend-filter pages (what a 10-month trend filter did to each portfolio), 16 risk breakdowns (share of risk vs share of money) and 12 rule-robustness pages (does the 200-day average or the golden cross survive other settings, costs and held-out years). Each result returns the title, current verdict, 3-7 headline numbers with the data month, and the last change-log entries. Use it to give a sourced, dated answer to 'does the 200-day average work on SPY', 'would a trend filter have helped All Weather in 2022', 'how far back does VXUS go'. `query` is free words, a ticker or a portfolio name; `slug` returns one page in full (e.g. 'risk/classic-60-40', 'robustness/sma-200-spy'). Read-only and precomputed from the monthly refresh. For live numbers on your own allocation use analyze_portfolio or run_backtest.

limit.description: Maximum results for a search (1-10). Default 5.

query.description: Words, a ticker or a portfolio name, e.g. '200-day SPY', 'all weather trend', 'VXUS', 'golden cross'.

set.description: Restrict to one page set: strategies, history, trend, risk or robustness. Default any.

slug.description: Exact page as '<set>/<id>', e.g. 'risk/classic-60-40' or 'robustness/sma-200-spy'. Returns that page in full (every number, labels, change log); `query` is ignored.

name: find_guides
